chunks: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and al-Razzaz (all), and Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
"The one who does not conceive (like her) has no waiting period (iddah) upon her."
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period (iddah) for a woman divorced before consummation who did not conceive?
ai.summary: This hadith from the chapter on women's waiting periods clarifies that a woman divorced before consummation, provided she is confirmed not to have conceived, is exempt from observing an iddah. This ruling, attributed to Imam al-Baqir, underscores the principle that iddah in this specific context serves primarily to ascertain lineage, a nuance highlighted by Shia jurists when distinguishing between pre-consummation and post-consummation divorces.
